summary: Tested 3 bug fixes after season rollover for RegistraTEAM. BUG 1 (backend): GET /api/users/dirigenti now returns 4 users (CIUCHETTI admin, TEST DIRIGENTE dirigente, MARZO LELLA viewer, PINELLI LIVIA viewer) instead of empty array. Self-heal confirmed in DB: all 4 users have '2026-2027' in active_seasons. Multi-tenancy holds (society_id filter respected). BUG 2 & 3 verified via code review of the Expo/React Native app (playwright UI automation not applicable to native app served via Expo).

minor.issue: Returns TEST DIRIGENTE with status='suspended' too. Endpoint does not filter by status. If intent is 'approved/pending only', add status filter; otherwise OK. Not a regression from this fix.

action_items: (Optional) Consider whether TEST DIRIGENTE (status=suspended) should appear in /api/users/dirigenti — endpoint has no status filter.

UI verification of BUG 2 (preseason expand/collapse) and BUG 3 (coordinatore badge) was done via code review only — the app is Expo/React Native; recommend manual smoke test in the Expo web preview if needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 4738: query uses `$or: [{rollover_decision:{$ne:'removed'}},{rollover_decision_season:{$ne:current}}]` — this correctly excludes only users with BOTH rollover_decision='removed' AND rollover_decision_season==current_season (via De Morgan). Verified in DB and via live API.
preseason.tsx lines 164/627/684: expandedCards Set + isExpanded gate + data-testid='campaign-toggle-{id}' + chevron up/down toggle — all in place and correct.
coordinatore/index.tsx lines 65-77: badge with data-testid='coordinatore-role-badge', Ionicons 'school' (graduation-cap), text 'COORDINATORE' — implemented correctly.
seed_data_creation: None. Did not create coordinator test account (BUG 3 verified via code review since UI is React Native).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fix for dirigenti visibility after rollover is confirmed working. Users self-heal into current season (2026-2027) on GET. Multi-tenancy respected. The pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_dirigenti_rollover_visibility.py can be reused. UI (Expo RN) needs manual QA for expand/collapse and coordinator badge — code inspection shows correct implementation.
rca of the issue: Pre-fix query filtered by `active_seasons: current_season`, which excluded staff whose active_seasons were not updated during rollover (bug in rollover routine, or accounts created before). Post-fix uses inverse rollover_decision filter + idempotent self-heal via $addToSet. Live API returns the 4 expected users; DB shows '2026-2027' added to active_seasons for all.
